nominal_scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

budget_intent.policy: 14k triangles and 1,000,000 bytes are ceilings, not targets. Usually aim about 100–500 KB; below this range is fine. Spend more triangles only for visible silhouette/proportion/connection benefit. Do not pad counts or enlarge textures for apparent refinement. Preserve quality if a justified asset exceeds the usual range within the hard caps.

start_gate: explicit parent exclusive dispatch in claim.json
concurrency: Parent-coordinated shared host pool; default one worker x two Blender threads, no per-batch full-host allocation.
repair_scope: Existing five attached mature follicles become modest capsule/pod bodies with blunt-curved tips and one ordinary-view readable longitudinal geometric suture. Preserve long/short shoot attachment, five count and single maturity; no leaves/seeds/tree or micro-noise. Other three PASS models and original r001 complete trees remain unchanged.

follicle_repair_geometry.profile: elongate capsule with short blunt-curved end transitions
follicle_repair_geometry.suture: one real upper longitudinal trough with modest valve shoulders; fade at ends
follicle_repair_geometry.maturity: single mature attached follicle stage; no opened fruit or seeds
